TITLE: Imported Work Order – Page Shows No Lead Technician at All
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10047 · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: PROBABLY NOT A DEFECT — PRD S4-N2 (no lead change in Imported status) is met: the imported page has no lead to change.

h2. Description

An *Imported* work order should show its *Lead Technician*, locked, so it cannot be changed.

For example,
* opening an imported work order goes to a separate imported page
* the page shows the number, *Imported*, *Invoiced: <date>*, Financial Info and the invoice
* there is no Lead Technician on the page at all

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open *Work Orders* > *List* > *All*, tick *Imported* in *Status* and open an imported work order.
#* A separate imported page opens.
# Look for *Lead Technician*.
#* It is not shown anywhere on the page.

*Actual Result:*
* The imported work order page shows no Lead Technician.

*Expected Result:*
* Lead Technician is shown and cannot be changed.
